active_capability: SERPIENTE forecast -> canonical scientific contract -> CeutIA decision

missions.objective: Make the canonical prediction contract temporally eligible, numerically finite and causally non-misleading at the CeutIA receiver.
missions.scientific_rationale: Prediction and causal inference are distinct; point-in-time availability and finite intervals are mandatory.
missions.engineering_rationale: Receiver now enforces decision-time eligibility, finite interval values and preserves causal abstention for predictive use.
missions.result: Implemented and exercised by the scientific traceability suite; current workflow run 24 is still in progress.
missions.remaining_work: Confirm current workflow run 24 and cross-repository producer compatibility.

missions.objective: Emit the CeutIA-owned canonical v1.1 scientific prediction contract from a real SERPIENTE Forecast without inventing applicability metadata.
missions.scientific_rationale: Model/method identity, training window, reference class, OOD state, calibration and provenance must be explicit.
missions.engineering_rationale: Producer adapter exists and pins the exact CeutIA canonical contract hash.
missions.result: Producer implementation exists; run 93 failed for an unrelated floating-point exactness assertion in outcome API, not the scientific producer tests.
missions.remaining_work: Re-run producer/runtime validation on a corrected SERPIENTE head and then connect authenticated transport.

missions.objective: Close SQLite/PostgreSQL forecast-outcome referential-integrity parity and revalidate persistence behaviour.
missions.scientific_rationale: Orphan outcomes invalidate prospective forecast evaluation.
missions.engineering_rationale: PostgreSQL parity was corrected; the next run was superseded/cancelled and the following run failed only on a floating-point equality assertion.
missions.result: Parity implementation is present. Current failure is numerical representation in an outcome API assertion, not referential integrity.
missions.remaining_work: Classify/fix the exact-value regression without weakening the scientific metric semantics, then rerun runtime validation.

missions.objective: Connect the canonical scientific prediction contract to the actual CeutIA decision endpoint so compatibility validation is executable at the governance boundary.
missions.scientific_rationale: A compatibility function is insufficient if the live decision path can bypass it.
missions.engineering_rationale: The real /decision/evaluate path now calls consume_serpiente_prediction, persists the accepted/rejected canonical record, and passes a dedicated prediction reference into the existing lifecycle.
missions.result: Runtime integration implemented. Canonical dict is now the only accepted SERPIENTE prediction representation at /decision/evaluate; the old envelope cannot bypass the scientific consumer. A deterministic integration test covers acceptance, persistence and prediction lineage; a regression test covers legacy-envelope rejection.
missions.remaining_work: Read current CeutIA run 24 to completion; then implement authenticated transport and replay before capability closure.

missions.objective: Establish authenticated transport and replay protection for canonical prediction delivery rather than relying on payload hashing alone.
missions.scientific_rationale: Integrity does not authenticate producer identity.
missions.engineering_rationale: The decision endpoint already authenticates decision requests, but the canonical SERPIENTE message has no producer-bound transport authentication.
missions.result: Not implemented yet; integrity hash alone is explicitly insufficient.
missions.remaining_work: Implement transport without creating a second prediction contract.

missions.objective: Reconstruct a canonical prediction exactly as known at decision time and prevent later information from contaminating replay.
missions.scientific_rationale: Prospective validation fails if replay uses later revisions.
missions.engineering_rationale: Canonical prediction persistence now exists; replay is the next temporal closure layer.
missions.result: Prediction record is durable; replay API/verification is not yet wired.
missions.remaining_work: Implement replay over the existing lineage/persistence architecture.

missions.objective: Package the closed Forecast -> Decision vertical into a reproducible customer-demonstrable capability without claiming prospective scientific validation.
missions.scientific_rationale: Commercial output must expose uncertainty, provenance, calibration/OOD status and the absence of prospective validation.
missions.engineering_rationale: A product capability requires an understandable output and reproducible demonstration in addition to runtime integration.
missions.result: Productization is intentionally downstream of the remaining P0/P1 integration chain.
missions.remaining_work: Create capability closure certificate and deterministic demonstration after replay/transport are closed.
